Rip.name: Accuracy
Rip.desc: Gives you an 20% chance to deal additional damage equal to the 60% of the weapon's attack power

Berserk.name: Berserk
Berserk.desc: Increases attack power by 25% and takes the damage equal to 8% of the weapon's attack power every time attacking the target

Power.name: Power
Power.desc: Increases Garrote Chance and Critical Strike Chance by 1.7%

Slow.name: Slow
Slow.desc: Gives you an additional 4% chance to reduce the target's movement by 30% and attack speed by 15%. Lasts 6 sec.

Corruption.name: Corruption
Corruption.desc: Gives you an additional 3% chance to reduce the target's health by 1% per sec. Lasts 5 sec.

Stun.name: Incapacitate
Stun.desc: Gives you an additional 3% chance to incapacitate the target. Lasts 5 sec.

Protection.name: Defensive Spirit Breath
Protection.desc: Reduces the effect of durative damage taken by 10%

Resilience.name: Resilience
Resilience.desc: Reflects 2% of damage taken to the attacker.

Luck.name: Luck
Luck.desc: "Increases parry chance, garrote chance and critical strike chance by 2%; reduces gear loss chance when meeting demise by 1%"

Fire.name: Fire
Fire.desc: Increases the effect duration of shapeshifting
